title: Fake election polls expose a Kalshi loophole that could leave traders paying for fraud
summary: Polling firm Wedgewood admitted on Oct. 20 that it fabricated most of its election surveys, and VoteHub, one of the aggregators that carried its results, is also the data source for recurring Kalshi contracts.
